claude-haiku-4-5.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
claude-haiku-4-5.note: Fastest Claude model. Supports structured outputs and PDFs (100 pages per request at 200K context). Does not accept the effort parameter.

claude-sonnet-5-5.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
claude-sonnet-5-5.note: Best speed and intelligence mix. Thinking cannot be sent as disabled (400). Forced tool_choice any/tool returns a 400, so tools run with tool_choice auto and strict tool schemas.

groq-gpt-oss-20b.label: GPT-OSS 20B on Groq
groq-gpt-oss-20b.note: Cheapest drafting option. Strict JSON schema outputs are supported, but structured outputs cannot be combined with tool use or streaming on Groq. Re-check price and availability before quoting it to a client.

support_agent.why: Answers are short and grounded in retrieved text, so speed and cost matter more than deep reasoning. Escalate complaints and ambiguous policy questions to Sonnet.

whatsapp_lead_agent.why: Replies must arrive in seconds and stay short, and leads write in several languages. Haiku handles both. Use Sonnet when a lead's message is long or the qualification is unclear.

inbox_manager.why: Triage is classification, which Haiku does with a strict schema. Drafts that a person will send under their own name use Sonnet. Backlogs can go through the Batch API at half price.

booking_agent.why: Booking is a multi-step tool loop where a wrong argument creates a real appointment. Sonnet 5.5 with strict tool schemas is the safe default. Haiku 4.5 is the budget option for simple one-service calendars.

document_extractor.why: Scanned and messy PDFs need the stronger model. Clean, digital PDFs of under 100 pages can go to Haiku at half the input price.
